choices.B: An action to relief suffer from death
choices.C: Medical provider’s directibes to treat patient before death as their wish
choices.D: Individual’s personal medical records with advance directives to require assistance form family and attorney because of their death
choices.E: To end a patient suffering from incurable and painful disease, by putting patient to death painlessly or intentionally allowing them to die
